(...) "Our second approach is based on the ground-state path integral form of AFQMC, but introduces several advances, including accelerated sampling (...) by a dynamic force bias [27], which enables global moves of fields on a time slice with acceptance ratio of over 90% (...) "In both approaches, the computational cost scales as ~ Ns N^2 beta." (...)
